# Motion-graphics skill repos (third party)

Twenty repos collected from "20 repo skill video motion graphics cho Claude" (giangxai.com).
They are NOT part of this project's code: each keeps its own licence. Read a repo's
LICENSE before copying anything from it into `templates/` or `.claude/skills/`.

| Repo | What it is | Licence note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [whaleyxbt/claude-motion](https://github.com/whaleyxbt/claude-motion) | Motion-design toolkit for coding agents; reviews its own frames, code-made audio | check repo |
| [howseen-ai/claude-motion-design](https://github.com/howseen-ai/claude-motion-design) | Video from HTML + Playwright + ffmpeg (no Remotion/AE) | check repo |
| [charlie947/motion-graphics-skills](https://github.com/charlie947/motion-graphics-skills) | 13 skills for product-intro videos, every frame is code | check repo |
| [haidrrrry/claude-remotion-skill](https://github.com/haidrrrry/claude-remotion-skill) | Claude as a Remotion editor: subtitles, B-roll, sound design | check repo |
| [t3knobox/klik-anim-skill-creation](https://github.com/t3knobox/klik-anim-skill-creation) | Animation principles, camera moves, Remotion workflow | **no licence** — read only |
| [Sunwood-ai-labs/hyperframes-motion-reel-skill](https://github.com/Sunwood-ai-labs/hyperframes-motion-reel-skill) | 120 BPM beat-cut showreel at 60 fps on HyperFrames | check repo |
| [AbubakrChan/product-launch-motion](https://github.com/AbubakrChan/product-launch-motion) | Full product-launch film: VO, camera, grade, beat-synced audio | check repo |
| [cth9191/animate](https://github.com/cth9191/animate) | Single-file canvas clips, 7 preset styles | check repo |
| [iart-ai/motion-design-skills](https://github.com/iart-ai/motion-design-skills) | Motion-design basics (timing, colour, type, layout) | check repo |
| [nateherkai/hyperframes-student-kit](https://github.com/nateherkai/hyperframes-student-kit) | 15 skills + 406 HyperFrames motion cards (reels, Shorts) | **own terms** — read first |
| [heygen-com/hyperframes](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes) | The HTML→video engine this project renders with | Apache-2.0 |
| [remotion-dev/remotion](https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion) | React video framework | **company licence** needed for teams > 3 |
| [remotion-dev/skills](https://github.com/remotion-dev/skills) | Official Remotion agent skills | check repo |
| [greensock/GSAP](https://github.com/greensock/GSAP) | JS animation library (HyperFrames timelines) | GSAP standard licence |
| [LottieFiles/motion-design-skill](https://github.com/LottieFiles/motion-design-skill) | Timing, easing, Disney's 12 principles, engine-agnostic | MIT |
| [frankxai/awesome-motion-design-agent-skills](https://github.com/frankxai/awesome-motion-design-agent-skills) | Curated list: GSAP, Motion, Remotion, Lottie, Rive | CC0 |
| [Barty-Bart/motion-graphics](https://github.com/Barty-Bart/motion-graphics) | Illustrative B-roll straight from a transcript | check repo |
| [199-biotechnologies/motion-dev-animations-skill](https://github.com/199-biotechnologies/motion-dev-animations-skill) | Motion.dev web animations (scroll, spring, drag) | MIT |
| [motiondivision/motion](https://github.com/motiondivision/motion) | React/JS animation library (ex Framer Motion) | MIT |
| [airbnb/lottie-web](https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-web) | Lottie player for the browser | MIT |
